reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. - Business-verified WING seller; HMAC keys + IP allow-list; no sandbox; per-API rate limits in the docs.

fields.name: access_key
fields.help: Coupang Open API Access Key issued in WING (판매자정보 > 추가판매정보 > OPEN API 키 발급) after business verification; calls must come from one of the (up to 10) allow-listed IPs, and keys expire and must be re-issued.

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: The matching Secret Key: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over signed-date + method + path + query, sent as `Authorization: CEA algorithm=HmacSHA256, access-key=..., signed-date=..., signature=...`). Never sent on the wire.

config_fields.name: vendor_id
config_fields.help: Coupang vendorId (업체코드, e.g. A00012345), shown in WING after login; used in every path/query.

adapter.terms: Coupang's Open API is SELLER-side (WING): it reads the seller's own listings and the customer orders placed with the seller. There is no buyer/sourcing API, so nothing here buys from Coupang.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists one registered product ({code, message, nextToken, data[]}) to verify the HMAC keys, IP allow-list and vendorId.

list_products.note: The seller's OWN registered products (GET_PRODUCTS_BY_QUERY). `query` searches sellerProductName (20 characters at most); `category` is not a filter of this endpoint. nextToken is the page key (1 or absent for the first page, the response's nextToken is the next one; empty when there is none).

get_product.note: GET_PRODUCT_BY_PRODUCT_ID: the full listing (delivery and return settings, items[{vendorItemId, itemName, originalPrice, salePrice, maximumBuyCount, externalVendorSku, images}]). `price` is the first item's salePrice in the market currency (KRW in Korea); vendorItemId (옵션ID) per item is in `raw`.

get_order.note: GET_ORDERSHEET_BY_ORDERID: a customer order placed with the seller; the first shipment box (data[0]) of that orderId. status is ACCEPT (결제완료), INSTRUCT (상품준비중), DEPARTURE, DELIVERING, FINAL_DELIVERY or NONE_TRACKING. Prices are {currencyCode, units, nanos} objects (orderItems[].orderPrice), so no numeric `total` is mapped; receiver and orderItems are in `raw`.

track.note: One row per shipment box of the order with its delivery status, carrier (deliveryCompanyName), invoiceNumber (운송장번호), shipped and delivered dates. The per-box status history endpoint (/ordersheets/{shipmentBoxId}/history) is not used: its documented schema (data[].details[]) and example (data[] of events) disagree.

not_offered.create_order: Seller-side API: customers order on coupang.com; the Open API only processes those orders (상품준비중, 운송장 업로드) and cannot place one.
not_offered.quote_shipping: No shipping-rate endpoint: delivery charges are fields of the seller's own listing (deliveryChargeType, deliveryCharge), not a quote for a destination.

live_check.notes: requires access_key, secret_key, vendor_id; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
